_comment: Every recording Noor may bundle (Adhans and sound effects; 0.17: the curated set the owner asked for on 16 November 2026). Each licence permits redistribution in a public repository and use in an app that may become commercial: public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA, never NC or ND. fetch_commons.py fetches and checks each file. kind 'commons' (default): a Wikimedia Commons file; the live licence must equal 'licence' or the file is refused. kind 'url': a file from an archive with a stated licence (US National Park Service, Internet Archive / radio aporee), with page, artist, licence and the file's SHA-1 recorded by hand; the download must match the SHA-1. kind 'local': a recording supplied by the app's owner, kept in tools/sounds/owner/ ('path' relative to this folder), e.g. {"id": "dubai", "kind": "local", "path": "owner/dubai.wav", "name": "Dubai Adhan (owner's recording)", "artist": "...", "licence": "...", "provenance": "who recorded it, where and when, who holds the rights and on what terms"}. Do not add recordings whose provenance is doubtful (for example broadcast captures or commercial releases re-uploaded as 'public domain'). Entries with "status": "candidate" and "sha1": null (Al-Quds and Egypt, found on Freesound, which refuses the cloud session) are fetched for review only: build_library.py does not use them until they have been listened to, cut and their SHA-1 pinned.

files.title: File:Maghrib Adhan at the Masjid al Haram, Mecca - 25 Feb, 2012.webm
files.provenance: Recorded at al-Masjid al-Haram before Maghrib and published on YouTube under CC BY by the recordist (3omar Faruq); licence confirmed by YouTubeReviewBot on 14 February 2020.

files.title: File:33937 ejaz215 call-to-prayer-from-the-prophet-s-mo.ogg
files.provenance: Recording of the call to prayer from the Prophet's Mosque, Madinah, published on Freesound by its recordist (ejaz215) under CC BY 3.0.

files.name: Dawn Chorus (Yellowstone National Park sound library)
files.provenance: Early-morning birdsong recorded near Mammoth Hot Springs, Yellowstone National Park, by the US National Park Service. The park's sound library states: "The files available here were recorded in the park and are in the public domain. They may be downloaded and used without limitation; however, please credit the National Park Service."

files.name: 28130 Houx, France - Chicken and rooster (radio aporee)
files.provenance: Field recording of a farm in the village of Houx, France (26 December 2016), published by the recordist on radio aporee ::: maps (aporee.org/maps/?loc=34557), archived on the Internet Archive with the licence CC BY 3.0.

files.name: Toucheng, Yilan County - Rocks and waves (radio aporee)
files.provenance: Waves on a rocky shore at Toucheng, Yilan County, Taiwan (29 July 2014; Zoom H6 and Rode NT4), published by the recordist on radio aporee ::: maps (aporee.org/maps/?loc=24350), archived on the Internet Archive with the licence CC BY 3.0.

files.name: Taitung County - Rain (radio aporee)
files.provenance: Steady rain at a village school in Taitung County, Taiwan (28 March 2018; Zoom H2n), published by the recordist on radio aporee ::: maps (aporee.org/maps/?loc=39377), archived on the Internet Archive with the licence CC BY 3.0.

files.name: Stream Soundscape from the Black Canyon Trail (Rocky Mountain National Park sound library)
files.artist: Jacob Job / National Park Service (Rocky Mountain National Park)
files.provenance: A mountain stream on the Black Canyon Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park, recorded by Jacob Job (Colorado State University and the NPS Natural Sounds and Night Skies Division). The park's sound library states that its recordings "are in the public domain and may be downloaded and used without limitation; however, please credit the National Park Service."

files.name: Israel_sanctum_sepulchrum_adhan.ogg (Freesound 191866)
files.provenance: The Adhan heard at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in the Old City of Jerusalem, uploaded to Freesound by Zabuhailo (tags: Jerusalem, Holy-Sepulcher, azan, Denis-Nelubin); 108.6 s, Ogg 48 kHz original. The nearest minarets are those of the Mosque of Omar and al-Khanqah al-Salahiyya, beside the church. Candidate, not yet in the app: found on 16 November 2026 through Openverse's index of Freesound (licence as indexed there); Freesound refuses the cloud session, so the file (Freesound's own high-quality preview, MP3 128 kbit/s; the original needs a Freesound login) is fetched by the Fetch workflow on GitHub and must be listened to, segmented and its licence confirmed on the Freesound page before its SHA-1 is pinned and it is used.
